profiles.description: Charters are shares of the Dove treasury. Each charter can be redeemed for its share of every treasury asset. One charter is one CHARTER token; a whole token can be held as an NFT, and only NFTs vote. Charter NFT holders govern the protocol and choose the strategies that receive treasury funds. Revenue from the DOVE pool and bond premiums closes each day: at launch, half raises the backing of every charter and half backs new charters, sold for DOVE in Dutch auctions that burn the DOVE paid. The charter pool burns its unit fees, which raises every holder's share.

DOVE is the floor-backed token of Dove. Any holder can redeem DOVE for its share of the WETH in the FloorReserve. Only bond sales can mint new DOVE, and each bond pays at least the floor value plus a premium, so new supply never lowers the floor. Part of every bond premium and 4/5 of the charter pool's WETH fees add to the floor, while pool fees and charter purchases burn DOVE.

Autonomous payments for AI agents. MCP server + SDK for the Machine Payments Protocol. Settlement runs transparently on-chain, in USDG, on Robinhood Chain 4663.

Pons MCP bridges AI agents with Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol, enabling autonomous service payments with transparent Robinhood Chain settlement.

- MPP Integration
Native support for Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol. Agents discover services, interpret 402 responses, and authorize payments.

- On-chain Settlement
USDG transfers settle transparently on Robinhood Chain (4663). Every payment ends with a verifiable receipt.

- Policy Protection
Per-transaction and daily caps are enforced before any funds move. Balance is checked before broadcast.

- Local Key Control
Signing lives in the configured MCP server process — never in the browser, never in third-party code.

- pons Intelligence
Read pons v1 launch metadata, canonical pools, socials, and live markets directly from agent tool calls.

- Receipt Verification
A payment is complete only when the on-chain receipt confirms the exact USDG transfer to the merchant.
